key_concepts: Body systems are groups of organs working together for a function.
The digestive system breaks down food and absorbs nutrients.
Food travels through the mouth, pharynx, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intest
The pancreas, liver, and gall bladder are accessory organs of digestion.
Mechanical digestion physically breaks food into smaller pieces.
Chemical digestion uses enzymes to break down food into simpler compounds.
Amylase breaks down carbohydrates, protease breaks down proteins, and lipase breaks down f
Peristalsis moves food through the digestive tract by involuntary muscle contractions.
Chyme is the semi-fluid mass of partially digested food formed in the stomach.
Villi and microvilli increase surface area for nutrient absorption in the small intestine.
Most nutrient absorption occurs in the small intestine, not the stomach.
The digestive system interacts with the nervous, endocrine, and immune systems.
